messages.subject: Quartz House - completion statement and funds
messages.plaintextBody:
Zoe,

Draft completion statement attached separately for agreement. It credits the £45,000 Unit 2 rent deposit and a £6,800 retention for the Carrington service-charge query, with apportionments of rent, service charge and insurance to 15 May. Balance due from us on completion is £7,572,760. Please confirm the figures and your client account details.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
